name: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
summary: A broken barrel on Westfall's western shore begins Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure trail. Its clue points north to an old jug beside a coastal windmill, one step closer to the late pirate's riches.

sections.title: A Pirate's Breadcrumb Trail
sections.body: Captain Sanders left clues that point only to the next hiding place. No single parchment shows where his plunder lies, so the trail stays unresolved until you find each message.

sections.title: North Toward the Bluffs
sections.body: The parchment sends you due north from the barrel to the sea cliffs. An isolated windmill stands on the bluffs, with another clue in an abandoned jug beside it. Murlocs and Defias scavengers roam the coast, making the way perilous.

faq.q: What is Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure?
faq.answer: Captain Sanders was a buccaneer who hid his riches along the Westfall coast. Instead of a map, he left written riddles in barrels, chests, and jugs across the countryside.

faq.q: Where does this third clue lead?
faq.answer: The parchment points due north from the broken barrel to the ocean bluffs. Near a lone windmill, an old jug holds the next clue.

faq.q: Why did Sanders hide his directions in pieces?
faq.answer: Sanders split his directions to protect his treasure from mutinous crewmates and rival marauders. One clue alone would not reveal the whole route.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this trail?
faq.answer: Yes. Any adventurer can follow Captain Sanders' clues and handle the objects tied to his cache, though Westfall lies deep in Alliance territory.

faq.q: Does this clue directly reveal the chest?
aliases: is the treasure in the jug
faq.answer: No. The jug near the coastal windmill holds another clue pointing to Sanders' chest. This is the penultimate step in the hunt.

faq.q: What dangers surround the trail to the windmill?
faq.answer: Riverpaw gnolls, coastal murlocs, and roving Defias bandits prowl Westfall's western bluffs and beaches. A straight march north can be treacherous.

angles.text: As a rogue, you may find a scoundrel's trail of concealed messages and hidden markers along the bluffs familiar.
With Westfall gripped by famine and Defias outlaws, Sanders' lost pirate plunder offers you a welcome windfall.
